name: Corned Beef and Cabbage – Jamaican Style
assumptions: Yield estimated at 4 servings based on total ingredient quantities (approx. 1.35 kg) typical for a main dish serving 4 adults with rice/bread as suggested.
Minutes estimated from summed instruction times (3-5 min sauté + 1 min garlic + 3-5 min cabbage + 3-5 min final simmer) using midpoints, excluding negligible 'to taste' seasoning and serving steps.

'Corned Beef' conservatively classified as containing possible wheat (from potential curing agents or fillers in canned products) and soy (common in some processed meats), hence null for those allergens.
Ketchup classified as containing possible soy (from potential additives), hence null for soy allergen.
Thyme, salt, and pepper treated as single-ingredient items with no allergens.
No barley, rye, or wheat explicitly listed, but gluten-free left null due to processed meat uncertainty; recipe is wheat-free if corned beef has no wheat but not certified gluten-free.
All other diets and allergens assigned true/false only when ingredients allow confident classification without ambiguity.
instructions:
Heat olive oil in a skillet or Dutch pot over medium-high heat. Add onion and green pepper and sauté for about 3-5 minutes.
Add garlic and stir for about 1 minute.
Add shredded cabbage and stir. Cook for about about 3-5 minutes, stirring often until softened.
Add corned beef, Roma tomatoes, and thyme and stir. Add ketchup and scotch bonnet pepper sauce and stir. Reduce heat and cook on medium for about 3-5 minutes, until the corned beef is heated through. Remove from heat.
Serve with white rice, bread, or on its own.
